// INERT SOURCE: read as text; never execute or import.
const orderEvents = defineMessage("orders.cancelled.v1", "OrderCancelled", {
  orderId: "string", status: "string", reason: "string"
});
const secondaryEvents = defineMessage("returns.cancelled.v1", "OrderCancelled", {
  orderId: "string", status: "string"
});

async function cancelOrder(db, broker, billingHttp, orderId, operatorReason) {
  const tx = await db.begin("orders", "read committed");
  const row = await tx.query(
    "UPDATE orders SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id, status",
    [orderId]
  );
  const reason = `${row.status}:${operatorReason}`;
  const event = { orderId: row.id, status: row.status, reason };
  await broker.publish("orders.primary", orderEvents, event);
  await broker.publish("orders.secondary", orderEvents, event);
  // Publication precedes commit; this is neither an outbox nor atomic delivery.
  await tx.commit();
  await billingHttp.invokeOperation("billing.cancel-order.v1", { orderId });
  return row.status;
}

async function cancelReturn(broker, returnRow) {
  const event = { orderId: returnRow.orderId, status: returnRow.status };
  await broker.publish("returns.primary", secondaryEvents, event);
}
const ordersDatabase = configureDatabase("orders", { dialect: "postgresql" });
bindDatabase(cancelOrder, ordersDatabase);
bindDatabase(sweepCancelled, ordersDatabase);
